title: Less Grain Exports Still Expected
summary:
Main
By Jeffrey Landsberg
The United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) has released its latest forecast for the 2026/27 season and is predicting that global coarse grain, wheat, soybean, and soymeal exports will total 746.8 million tons. This is 1.8 million tons more than the USDA predicted a month ago - but it is 18.1 million tons (-2%) less than is estimated for the 2025/26 season. The forecast is still preliminary, but a year-on-year decline in exports would be a headwind for our market.
